company: Amazon Web Services, Inc. (a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc.)

ownership.quote: EC2 Mac instances are part of Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), a service of Amazon Web Services, Inc., a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc.

stage.quote: Amazon.com, Inc. is listed on NASDAQ under the ticker AMZN.
stage.note: AWS/EC2 Mac is a product line inside Amazon.com, Inc., a public company (NASDAQ: AMZN); not independently funded.

revenue.basis: Amazon.com, Inc. 10-K filing: AWS segment net sales for fiscal year 2024. EC2 Mac itself is a single instance family within EC2/AWS and its standalone revenue is not disclosed.
revenue.quote: AWS segment sales increased 19% year-over-year to $107.6 billion in 2024.

employees.source: Amazon.com, Inc. 10-K (2024 fiscal year, company-wide headcount, not AWS- or EC2 Mac-specific)

note: AWS EC2 Mac (Dedicated Host) is a hardware-leasing product within Amazon EC2/AWS, itself a segment of Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN), a public company. There is no independent funding history, accelerator participation, or standalone revenue disclosure for the EC2 Mac product; figures given are for Amazon.com/AWS as a whole.
